scope: Historical, read-only audit of the reference address. It is not the current Dublin account and no production settings are changed.

history.participation_definition: The denominator is the 7,680 BTC 5-minute markets represented by the address-specific state-machine result, not every market listed on the platform. Every one of those observed markets has at least one reference Activity record/batch.

momentum_observation.warning: These are post-trade historical correlations. They do not prove the reference bot used Binance momentum or that the signal is predictive after costs.

verified_rewards.source: Polygon eth_getTransactionReceipt Transfer logs cross-checked against public Activity reward records
verified_rewards.date_coverage_reason: The local reward artifact stores block numbers and exact transfer amounts but no block timestamps or per-transfer calendar dates. The 30-day Activity history window must not be treated as proof that every reward transfer falls inside the same calendar window without a block-timestamp crosswalk.
verified_rewards.amount_scope: These rewards belong to the reference address only and are not current Dublin-account revenue.

what_is_confirmed: Within the address-specific BTC 5-minute Activity set, all 7,680 observed markets have at least one recorded trade batch.
The address frequently traded in small batches, with a 30-share median and a 3-second median gap.
When one side was heavier, the next observed batch repaired the light side 53.2168% of the time.
All 77 historical reward transfers were exactly matched on-chain, with 49,531.8272 USDC total across the three labeled types.
what_is_not_confirmed: Participation in every platform BTC 5-minute market, because the denominator is the address-specific observed set rather than a platform-wide market catalog.
Unrealized or realized trading profit after entry price, exit price, fees, and settlement; the available state-machine artifact is behavior/inventory evidence, not a complete PnL ledger.
Exact reward calendar dates from the local reward artifact.
Whether the reference address earned rewards because of a particular quote width, queue position, or unobserved resting order; public Activity does not expose those orders.
implication_for_local_testing: Use the 7680-market observed coverage and the 30-share/3-second/repair behavior as behavioral targets. Do not copy the 49,531.8272 USDC reward total into a current-account backtest. Model reward income as a separately verified, parameterized sensitivity until current-account reward eligibility and dated transfers are available.
